name: Hillwalker Murdo

intro.text: Munros! There are 282 mountains over 3,000 feet in Scotland, and I'm on 190. I'm going to bag them all. When my knees let me.

win: A fine hand. You'd make a decent Munro-bagger.
after: Sir Hugh Munro made the list in 1891. He never climbed them all himself. He ran out of time. We have that in common.
